name: after-effects-mcp-pro
description: Drive Adobe After Effects from Claude: comps, layers, text, shapes, keyframes, effects, layer styles, previews and rendering.
long_description: MCP server for Adobe After Effects (2022 or newer, Windows and macOS). Builds comps, layers, text, shapes, masks, keyframes, expressions, effects and layer styles; previews frames and contact sheets so Claude can look at the result; renders in the background with aerender. Run the setup once (`npx after-effects-mcp-pro setup`) to install the fast listener inside After Effects; without it the server uses direct mode.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Check the connection to After Effects: install found, AE running, bridge mode (listener/direct), AE version, open project. Call this first if anything fails.

tools.name: launch_after_effects
tools.description: Start After Effects if it is not running and wait until it accepts commands (can take 30-120s).

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Fast project overview: counts by type, first 50 comps, active comp. detail:true lists every comp.

tools.name: list_project_items
tools.description: List project panel items (compositions, footage, solids, folders) with ids, folders, sizes, missing-footage flags. Paginated: limit (default 200, max 1000) and offset; the response has total and truncated.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the project, or 'Save As' when path is given.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open an .aep file. Refuses if the current project has unsaved changes unless discardChanges is true.

tools.name: new_project
tools.description: Close the current project and create an empty one. Refuses on unsaved changes unless discardChanges is true.

tools.name: import_files
tools.description: Import footage/images/audio/PSD/AI files (optionally as image sequence) into the project, into a folder, and optionally straight into a comp.

tools.name: remove_unused_footage
tools.description: Delete footage no layer uses. type:'solid' only clears unused null/solid sources; keep: ids to preserve.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the project panel.

tools.name: organize_items
tools.description: Move project items into a folder (created if missing).

tools.name: modify_item
tools.description: Rename, relabel, comment, replace footage source, conform frame rate, set loop count, or delete a project item.

tools.name: list_compositions
tools.description: All compositions with id, size, duration, fps, layer count, work area.

tools.name: get_composition
tools.description: Full composition details: settings, markers, selection and a summary of each layer (type, timing, transform, effects, parent, matte). At most layerLimit (default 200) layers; use list_layers to page through more.

tools.name: create_composition
tools.description: Create a comp (preset 1080p|4k|vertical|square... or width/height). open:false is faster when you add many layers first.

tools.name: set_composition_settings
tools.description: Change composition name, size, duration, fps, background, work area, motion blur, shutter, renderer, current time, resolution.

tools.name: duplicate_composition
tools.description: Duplicate a composition.

tools.name: open_composition
tools.description: Open a composition in the viewer/timeline and optionally move the playhead.

tools.name: precompose_layers
tools.description: Pre-compose layers into a new composition.

tools.name: create_text_layer
tools.description: Create a text layer with full styling (font, size, color, stroke, tracking, leading, alignment, caps). Anchor is centered on the text. Returns the font AE actually used.

tools.name: create_shape_layer
tools.description: Create a shape layer with one or many shapes (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, custom path), fill/stroke, rounded corners, Trim Paths and Repeater.

tools.name: create_solid_layer
tools.description: Create a solid color layer, or an adjustment layer (adjustment: true).

tools.name: create_null_layer
tools.description: Create a null object, optionally parenting layers to it.

tools.name: create_camera
tools.description: Create a 3D camera (two-node). Set zoom or focal length (mm), depth of field, focus distance, aperture.

tools.name: create_light
tools.description: Create a light (point, spot, parallel, ambient) with color, intensity, cone and shadows.

tools.name: add_item_to_comp
tools.description: Add a project item (footage, image, audio, or another comp) as a layer. fitToComp scales it to fit or fill the frame.

tools.name: set_time_remap
tools.description: Enable time remap and write its keyframes: speed (2 = twice as fast, out point adjusted), ramp (speed with easing), freeze (hold the frame at comp time 'at'), reverse, or keyframes [{time, sourceTime}].

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: List layers of a comp with type, timing, transform, parent, matte and effects (text cut to 200 chars). Paginated: limit (default 200, max 1000) and offset; the response has total and truncated.

tools.name: get_layer_details
tools.description: Deep inspection of a layer: modified/animated property tree with keyframes and expressions, markers, bounding box.

tools.name: set_layer_properties
tools.description: Change transform, timing, switches (enabled, solo, shy, lock, 3D, motion blur, adjustment, collapse), blend mode, quality, parent, label or name on one or many layers.

tools.name: duplicate_layer
tools.description: Duplicate a layer one or more times, optionally offsetting position and time for each copy.

tools.name: delete_layers
tools.description: Delete one or more layers. removeSources:true also deletes the Solids-folder item of deleted nulls/solids when nothing else uses it.

tools.name: reorder_layer
tools.description: Move a layer to top/bottom, to an index, or before/after another layer.

tools.name: set_parent
tools.description: Parent layers to another layer (or unparent with parent: null).

tools.name: set_track_matte
tools.description: Use another layer as alpha/luma (inverted) matte. Uses the AE 2023+ API so any layer can be the matte.

tools.name: split_layer
tools.description: Split a layer at a time (default: playhead).

tools.name: sequence_layers
tools.description: Place layers one after another (with optional overlap) or stagger their start times.

tools.name: align_layers
tools.description: Align layers to the composition (left/center/right, top/center/bottom) using their real visual bounds, with an optional margin.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Change the text and/or style of a text layer (font, size, color, stroke, tracking, leading, justification).

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Read any property by path ('Position', 'Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness', 'Contents/Group 1/...'): value, keyframes, expression.

tools.name: set_property
tools.description: Set any property's value by path. If the property is animated, sets a keyframe at 'time' (or the playhead).

tools.name: set_keyframes
tools.description: Add many keyframes to any property in one call, with easing presets or custom ease per key. Use replace:true to clear existing keys first.

tools.name: remove_keyframes
tools.description: Remove keyframes from a property (all, or within a from/to time range).

tools.name: set_expression
tools.description: Set or clear (empty string) an expression on any property. Returns the expression error right away if AE reports one.

tools.name: check_expressions
tools.description: Find every expression in a comp and report the ones that error.

tools.name: add_text_animator
tools.description: Add a text animator: properties (opacity, position, scale, rotation, tracking, blur, fillColor, strokeColor, skew) driven by a range, wiggly or expression selector; optionally animate the range (offset/start/end from->to).

tools.name: apply_expression_preset
tools.description: Apply a ready expression (with its own Slider controls when useful): loop-cycle, loop-pingpong, inertia-bounce, wiggle-controlled, link-to-slider, time-remap-loop, follow-layer, fit-text-box, counter-number.

tools.name: keyframes_from_markers
tools.description: Put a keyframe on a property at every comp (or layer) marker: values one per marker, or pattern:'alternate' cycling values. Animate on the beat.

tools.name: position_along_path
tools.description: Animate a layer's Position along a mask path or shape path of another layer: keyframes at every vertex, timed by path length (constant speed), with the path's curves as spatial tangents; autoOrient turns it along the path.

tools.name: animate_layer
tools.description: One-call animation preset: fade-in/out, slide-in/out, pop, scale-in, blur-in, typewriter, text-fade-up, wiggle, pulse, float, bounce, loop... e.g. {layer:'Title', preset:'pop', startTime:0.5}.

tools.name: list_available_effects
tools.description: Search all installed effects (incl. third-party plugins) by name, match name or category.

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.description: Apply any effect by display name or match name to one or many layers and set parameters by name/match name/index. Param value can be {keyframes:[...]} or {expression:'...'}. Returns all parameters with their values.

tools.name: get_layer_effects
tools.description: List effects on a layer with every parameter value.

tools.name: modify_effect
tools.description: Change parameters of an effect already on a layer, rename, enable/disable, reorder, duplicate or remove it.

tools.name: apply_effect_template
tools.description: Apply a ready-made look (glow, neon, drop-shadow, cinematic-look, film-grain, vignette...) to layers.

tools.name: apply_preset_file
tools.description: Apply an Animation Preset (.ffx) file to a layer.

tools.name: add_layer_style
tools.description: Add a Photoshop-style layer style (drop-shadow, inner-shadow, outer-glow, inner-glow, bevel-emboss, satin, color-overlay, gradient-overlay, stroke) and set its parameters by name (Color, Opacity, Size, Distance, ...). The result lists the available parameters.

tools.name: modify_mask
tools.description: Change an existing mask (by name or index): mode, inverted, feather, expansion, opacity, a new shape (rect/ellipse/vertices), and keyframes for path/feather/expansion/opacity. Path keyframe values are {shape, rect} or {vertices, inTangents, outTangents, closed}.

tools.name: add_mask
tools.description: Add a rectangle, ellipse or custom path mask with mode, feather, opacity, expansion and inversion. rect is [x,y,w,h] in layer space (default: layer bounds).

tools.name: remove_masks
tools.description: Remove one mask (by name or index) or all masks from a layer.

tools.name: audio_to_keyframes
tools.description: Run Convert Audio to Keyframes on an audio/video layer: creates an 'Audio Amplitude' null with Left/Right/Both Channels sliders keyframed per frame.

tools.name: markers_from_audio_peaks
tools.description: Add comp markers at the local peaks of the 'Audio Amplitude' Both Channels slider above threshold (beat markers). Run audio_to_keyframes first.

tools.name: markers
tools.description: Comp or layer markers in one tool: action add {time, comment, duration...} | list {includeLayers} | remove {time?, comment?}. With layer: that layer's markers.

tools.name: add_marker
tools.description: Add a comp marker (or a layer marker when layer is given) with comment, duration, chapter, URL and label.

tools.name: list_markers
tools.description: List comp markers (and layer markers with includeLayers).

tools.name: remove_markers
tools.description: Remove markers from a comp or layer, all or filtered by time/comment.

tools.name: preview_frame
tools.description: Render one frame of a composition and return it as an image, so you can SEE the result and check your work. maxSize downscales (default 960px). JPEG by default (3-5x smaller than PNG).

tools.name: preview_contact_sheet
tools.description: Render N frames (or given times) as ONE labelled grid image to check an animation over time.

tools.name: add_to_render_queue
tools.description: Queue a comp for rendering: format h264|prores|prores-alpha|lossless|tiff or outputModuleTemplate, outputPath, start/duration. PNG frames: render_png_sequence.

tools.name: render_png_sequence
tools.description: Write numbered PNG frames of a comp directly: outputPath 'C:/out/frame_[####].png', range by start/duration or startFrame/endFrame.

tools.name: get_render_queue
tools.description: List render queue items, status and output files.

tools.name: clear_render_queue
tools.description: Remove render queue items (all, or only finished ones).

tools.name: render_queue
tools.description: The render queue in one tool: action render (default: renders the queue, blocking AE until done) | list | clear | add (same arguments as add_to_render_queue). Prefer render_in_background for long renders.

tools.name: render_in_background
tools.description: Render a comp with aerender in a separate process (project is saved first). wait:true waits with per-frame progress.

tools.name: get_background_render
tools.description: Status, progress and log tail of background renders.

tools.name: replace_footage
tools.description: Swap the source file of a footage item (or a still/image sequence) for another file. Every comp that uses it keeps its layers, timing and effects.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List .ffx animation presets from the user's User Presets folder and the After Effects Presets folder, with name filter. Use the path with apply_preset_file.

tools.name: get_properties_at_time
tools.description: Read many properties of many layers at one time in one call: requests [{layer, properties:[...]}].

tools.name: list_essential_properties
tools.description: Without layer: list the Essential Graphics controllers of a comp. With layer (a precomp layer in comp): list that instance's Essential Properties with their current values.

tools.name: set_essential_property
tools.description: Set an Essential Property value on one precomp layer instance (by name or 1-based index), e.g. change the title text or color of one use of a template comp.

tools.name: set_essential_properties
tools.description: Set several Essential Properties of one precomp instance by name in one call: values {"Texto": "Ao vivo", "Cor": "#ff3366"}.

tools.name: instantiate_template
tools.description: Place a template comp N times into another comp, each with its own name, position and Essential Property values: items [{name, position, values}].

tools.name: export_mogrt
tools.description: Export a comp with Essential Graphics controllers as a Motion Graphics Template (.mogrt). path: a folder, or a full .mogrt file path (its name becomes the template name).

tools.name: add_to_essential_graphics
tools.description: Expose a property of a layer in its comp's Essential Graphics panel (optionally with a custom name) so precomp instances can override it.

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.description: Search installed fonts; returns PostScript names to use in text tools (AE 2024+).

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: What the user has selected in AE right now: active comp, playhead, selected layers and properties. Great for 'animate this layer' requests.

tools.name: select_layers
tools.description: Select layers in the timeline (empty list clears the selection).

tools.name: begin_undo_group
tools.description: Group the following calls so ONE undo call reverts them all. Close with end_undo_group.

tools.name: end_undo_group
tools.description: Close the open undo group. The next undo call without steps reverts every call of the group.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo or redo the last After Effects steps. Every MCP call is a single undo step; right after end_undo_group, undo without steps reverts the whole group.

tools.name: execute_menu_command
tools.description: Execute an AE menu command by id or (English) menu name, e.g. 'Fit to Comp', 'Center Anchor Point in Layer Content'.

tools.name: run_extendscript
tools.description: Run custom ExtendScript (ES3 function body; `return` a value). AEMCP helpers and `args` are available. Disabled with AE_MCP_EVAL=off.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run many AE tools in ONE call and ONE undo step, e.g. [{tool:'create_text_layer',args:{...}},{tool:'animate_layer',args:{...}}]. Fails with isError + partial results; atomic:true reverts all.

toolset.title: Tool profile
toolset.description: full (93 tools), core (31) or minimal (10). Unlisted tools still work when called by name.

eval.title: run_extendscript
eval.description: on or off. off hides the custom-script tool (recommended for shared setups).

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only list_, get_ and preview_ tools.
